answer_1.quote: ... we evaluate 7 open-and closed-weights LLMs on both identifying puns and providing supporting rationales ...
answer_1.outputs: binary pun detection decisions and semi‑structured rationales (pun pair and senses)

answer_2.quote: We quantify the alignment between the LLM‑predicted pun pair (w′p , w′a) and the true pun/alternative word pair (w p , w a) using the pun pair agreement (PPA) metric.

answer_4.quote: We conducted an error analysis with five native English speakers ... annotators were asked to answer 7‑9 multiple‑choice questions ... rate pun quality ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answered a questionnaire with multiple‑choice and Likert‑scale items covering context support, word‑sense correctness, pun‑pair similarity, sense similarity, and overall pun quality.
